findings.message: `pagefront:collectionKind` at `$['data']['pagefront:collectionKind']` is `taxonomy`, which is not one of `category`, `collection`, `brand`.
findings.remediation: Declare `pagefront:collectionKind` as `category` (a node of the storefront's navigation tree), `collection` (a set outside the tree) or `brand` (the products sold under one label). Additional values require a spec amendment.
